llm.summary: This skill gives code-review instructions only and does not ask the agent to install, persist, exfiltrate, or modify anything.

dimensions.detail: The skill may cause the agent to inspect repository files for review context, but it does not request credentials, broad local indexing outside the repo, network access, or privileged environment access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, executable script, dependency declaration, remote payload retrieval, or package setup behavior is present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are scoped to user-requested review work, including reading relevant diffs, touched code, callers, tests, and documentation; the repo-reading expectation is disclosed and proportionate for code review.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, memory writing, background workers, privilege escalation, tool wrapping, or code mutation instructions are present; the artifact explicitly says it lists findings and changes no code.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is quality review of code diffs, and the artifact contains only markdown guidance for reviewing changes, identifying bugs, risks, tests, performance, and unnecessary code.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want the agent to perform thorough code reviews. Expect it to read diffs and related repository files to support its findings, but the inspected skill does not direct the agent to change files or access unrelated private data.
